title: Exclusion by classification: Pristine Fallacy, loud exclusion, click collapse
description: Most claims are the falsifiable definitions of The Minimum Viable Archive (#863): the Pristine Fallacy, classification asymmetry, network erasure, custodial enclosure, classifier model collapse, compositional bystanding, the Three Compressions theorem and the Obelus Principle, each stated with what would falsify it. Around them sit claims that moderation classifiers exclude dense or critical work by surface features, from the Johannes Sigil Medium erasure and the Liberatory Operator Set to Zenodotus' Book-Burning. The Click Collapse (#1091) contributes forecasts of continued organic decline and four falsifiers for its CTR and revenue claims.
